items.detail: Confirm Neon's restore window covers at least 7 days. items.detail: It sits in every commit of this public repository since the baseline, so taking it out of `.mcp.json` does not make it secret again. Owner action, by whoever holds the 21st.dev account that issued it (it was committed by the previous owner): revoke it at 21st.dev, create a new one and keep it in the `TWENTY_FIRST_API_KEY` environment variable. items.title: Billing could charge twice or get the plan wrong
items.detail: Checkout now refuses a college already on Placement Pro (it would have started a second subscription). The webhook keeps Pro while a payment is past due (the grace period `isPro` allows), takes the plan from the subscription's current state, so a retried "checkout completed" cannot switch Pro back on after a cancellation, and ignores events about an older subscription that would downgrade the current one. A late retry about an old subscription cannot take the row over either: another subscription only takes over with a Pro period that has not ended, and never while the college is on an active Pro plan. `app/api/checkout/route.ts`, `app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts`, `lib/server/subscriptions.ts`, `lib/entitlement.ts` · Done in "Stop double charges and wrong plans in checkout and the Stripe webhook" and "Stop a late Stripe retry for an old subscription taking over billing"
